title: Photography dont’s
slide_intent: Give editors visible reasons to decline an image when its exposure, focus or composition obscures what the viewer should see.
strategic_value: Clear rejection criteria can keep low-quality photography from weakening how the museums present their collections and visitors.
demonstration: A checklist of faults sits beside a montage crossed through with thin red diagonals. The examples include blurred people and scenes with competing focal points.
practical_value: Check focus, exposure, focal point, filters and signs of staging before approving a photograph for publication.
